title: Ezee Original Powder Hair Colour Natural Black

details.description: Godrej Expert Original powder hair colour in natural black. 100% grey coverage, long lasting, no ammonia. Pack of 8 sachets.
details.usageInstructions: Mix the powder with the liquid as directed on the pack, apply on dry hair and rinse after the time stated on the pack.
details.dangerWarnings: For external use only. Do a patch test 48 hours before use. Avoid contact with eyes; if it happens, rinse well with water. Do not use if you have a skin allergy or scalp irritation. Keep away from children.
